approvalCard.always.intro: Future matching actions for this bot will be allowed by this rule:
approvalCard.ask.label: Tell {bot} what to do instead, or ask it something. The action is not taken; the bot reads your words and continues from there.
approvalCard.askMore: @{bot} before {target}: what is this for, what will it change, and is there a way that needs no approval?
approvalCard.egressWhy: {host} is not on this workspace's allowed list. Allowing it adds the site for every bot on this computer.
approvalCard.redirect: Tell it what to do instead
approvalCard.redirect.actionTitle: Tell the bot what to do instead; it rethinks without taking this action
approvalCard.redirect.siteTitle: Tell the bot what to do instead; it rethinks without opening the site
approvalCard.summaryUnavailable: Summary unavailable. Review the action details before deciding.
approvalCard.unclassifiedWhy: No tier table names this tool, so it asks by default.
approvals.empty.body: Runs waiting on a human will show up here.
approvals.empty.nextDoes: decide a request here or in its chat when a bot asks before an external action
approvals.empty.title: Nothing pending
approvals.expiry.hint: A request nobody decides in this time is not done, and the bot is told so. People get one reminder before then.
approvals.expiry.label: Expire undecided requests after
approvals.intro: Actions a bot may not take on its own. Deciding here is the same as deciding in the conversation; any member of the thread can answer.
approvals.mode.approveAll.hint: Every action that would ask is allowed without asking anyone, deletions, permission changes and new sites included; a bot that runs out of turns continues on its own. Private addresses stay blocked, and the budget and loop limits still apply. Every allowance is recorded.
approvals.mode.automatic.hint: An independent AI reviewer answers requests first, scheduled runs and browser actions included, so bots do not wait for someone to be online. Deleting, changing permissions, opening new sites and actions that carry credentials still wait for a person. Every decision is recorded.
approvals.mode.badge.title: This workspace allows every action that would ask, without asking anyone.
approvals.mode.legend: Who answers a request that needs approval
approvals.mode.manual.hint: Every request waits for a person or a teammate bot in the chat.
approvals.mode.title: Approvals
approvals.title: Approvals
integrationApprovalPreview.truncated: Preview truncated. Review the complete content before allowing.
